explore_status: exploratory: not part of prereg v0-v2 and changes no registered contrast, margin, threshold or verdict (prereg/decisions.md 2026-09-30)

explore_account_predictors.gap_linear: B x D from a least-squares line in r1 - r0, fitted on the training cells
explore_account_predictors.class_mean: mean B x D of the training cells of the same class (definition against other)
explore_account_predictors.class_branch_mean: mean B x D of the training cells of the same class and branch
explore_account_predictors.grand_mean: mean B x D of all training cells (no predictor)
explore_account_predictors.gap_identity: B x D = r1 - r0 (the account without the D effect of the write path)
explore_account_predictors.gap_and_class: least-squares on r1 - r0 and the class indicator (definition against rest)
explore_account_predictors.corrected: the identity (r1 - a1) - (r0 - a0) on the cell itself: a check, not a prediction
